title_as_printed: Solubilities of gases (in c.c. at N.T.P.) per 1000 g. of water at a total gas pressure of 1 atm. (s0).
pressure_note: 'at a total gas pressure of 1 atm.' (table title); whether this includes water vapour is not stated

value.col: s0 cc NTP per 1000 g water
value.what: cc of gas (at N.T.P.) dissolved per 1000 g of water at 1 atm total gas pressure; reference state N.T.P. not defined in the paper; printed per 1000 g water, scale 0.001 gives cm3 per g water

volume_basis_evidence: quantity is gas volume per 1000 g of water (mass basis of solvent), not per volume of solution
conversion_needs: N.T.P. not defined ('standard conditions' not stated; 273.15 K and 1 atm presumably but unstated)
gas pressure 1 atm total; water vapour correction not stated
notes: Nine gas blocks stacked in printed order: H2, CH4, C2H6, C3H8, n-C4H10, C2H4, N2, O2, CO2 (CO2 has two printed column pairs, left pair first then right pair, rows in increasing T). Gas is a label row per block. Printed mid-dot decimals written with full stop. Printed solubility of CO2 near 12-75 C ranges 1059 to 300.6. Ethylene, propane and n-butane are outside the seven gases; kept. Text says water determinations were made at about ten points between 12 and 75 C.
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: N.T.P. is not defined anywhere in the paper (the builder applies its 0 C, 1 atm convention, tagged stp-assumed). Possible misprint as printed: ethane 12.3 C 53.46 followed by 12.6 C 52.60 (slope about 2.9 per K against about 1.3 per K for the following rows); cells kept as printed.
